title: Call one endpoint
description: This Actor is an API. The fastest way to use it is to send HTTP requests to its server URL (see the Server tab). You can also make a single API call with this form, which is handy for schedules and integrations.

path.title: Endpoint path
path.description: Path of the endpoint to call, for example /v1/items/42. The Server tab and the README list all endpoints.

query.title: Query parameters
query.description: Query string parameters as a JSON object, for example {"limit": 10}.

body.title: Request body
body.description: JSON body for POST, PUT and PATCH endpoints.
